meta.title: Enzo · Web designer and developer
meta.description: I design and build websites that make the right impression and get clients messaging you on WhatsApp. Business websites, landing pages and maintenance.

hero.title: Your website is your first handshake.
hero.subtitle: I design and build websites that make the right impression and get clients messaging you on WhatsApp.
hero.note: Design and code by the same person, from first sketch to launch.

services.title: Three ways to start.
services.intro: Every project starts with understanding your business. The format comes later.

s1.title: Business websites
s1.text: Your brand's official address: who you are, what you offer and how to reach you. Several pages, organized so clients find what they're looking for.

s2.title: Landing pages
s2.text: One page, one goal: get the visitor to act. Great for launching a product, a service or a campaign.
s2.i1: Copy and flow built to convert

s3.title: Maintenance
s3.text: Already have a website, but it's stale, slow or out of date? I fix it, tune it and keep everything running.

process.title: Think before you design.
process.intro: A short, clear process. You know what happens at every step and you're never left waiting for an answer.

s1.title: Talk
s1.text: We talk about your business, your clients and what the website needs to solve. That turns into a plan and a quote.

s2.title: Design
s2.text: I design the screens and show them to you before any code. We adjust together until it's right.

s3.title: Development
s3.text: I turn the design into a fast website that works well on phones and computers.

s4.title: Live
s4.text: I publish the website, check every detail and show you how everything works. After that, I'm still around.

contact.title: Let's talk?
contact.text: Tell me what you have in mind, even if the idea is still rough. No strings attached.
contact.or: Or fill in the form: your message arrives ready to send on WhatsApp.
